description: One check before money moves on Base. Simulates the unsigned transaction, decodes approvals and transfers, screens the token and the recipient or spender, and applies a protected SpendGuard policy when given. Returns ALLOW, REVIEW or BLOCK with sourced findings. Fail-closed: no ALLOW unless every check ran. Does not detect prompt injection; use Protected SpendGuard for that. Paid tool: 0.005 USDC per call on Base via x402 (exact scheme). An unpaid call returns the payment requirement and charges nothing.

amount.description: Amount in token units, for the record.

expectedRecipient.description: Swap: who must receive the output. Default: from.

expectedTokenOut.description: Swap: token the swap must deliver; 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE for native ETH. For buy_token, tokenAddress is used when this is absent.

from.description: Wallet that will sign. Required in practice: without it the verdict is REVIEW (sender_unknown), because the transaction cannot be simulated from the signing wallet.

intent.description: What the agent means to do.

minAmountOut.description: Swap: smallest acceptable output, in token units (for example 25.5).

policy.description: Protected SpendGuard policy (send the agent key as Authorization: Bearer). Base USDC transfers only.

tokenAddress.description: Token to screen, when it is not the transaction destination (for example the token being bought).
